instructions.name: admin_close_user_escrow
docs: Admin-close a user_escrow PDA + its USDC ATA. Sweeps any residual USDC
to the user's main USDC ATA (init_if_needed). Used by the v1 cleanup
script after all offers are drained, before retiring the program.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Pays for the user's main USDC ATA init if it doesn't exist yet.
The user_escrow PDA rent (and its ATA rent) refund covers this many
times over, but the admin needs SOL up front per tx.
